# BlockBuddies Offline v1.5.81

This corrective Android release fixes the installation conflict reported for v1.5.80.

## Fixed

- Changed the downloadable debug APK to the separate package ID `com.blockbuddies.offline.preview`.
- The new build installs alongside an older BlockBuddies installation instead of being rejected because the signing certificates differ.
- Renamed the installed debug app to **BlockBuddies Preview** so it is easy to distinguish from the older installation.

## Included gameplay additions

- Blue, purple, and red light sabers with HUD blade controls.
- Hovering Void Orb pet.
- Shadow Oracle outfit.

## Included files

- `BlockBuddies-Offline-v1.5.81-debug.apk`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`

## Important installation note

This is a parallel-install preview build. It has its own app storage, so saved data from the older BlockBuddies package will not automatically appear in it. The older app does not need to be uninstalled.
